Two-layer MLP forward pass — ms/sample (lower is better)

performance_issues.name: Individual Database INSERTs in Loops
performance_issues.description: Database operations performed in tight loops without batching. Each INSERT triggers a separate transaction, causing 10-20x overhead.
performance_issues.recommendation: Implement batch_insert() method for bulk operations

performance_issues.name: Missing Internal Buffering in Monitoring
performance_issues.description: Monitor/tracker records each event immediately without buffering. High-frequency monitoring triggers excessive database I/O.
performance_issues.recommendation: Add internal batch buffering with configurable flush threshold

performance_issues.name: Synchronous I/O in Critical Paths
performance_issues.description: Synchronous file I/O or network calls in hot paths block execution. No async/await pattern, reducing throughput significantly.
performance_issues.recommendation: Use async I/O patterns and connection pooling

performance_issues.name: Inefficient List Comprehensions
performance_issues.description: Nested or complex list comprehensions creating unnecessary intermediate lists. Can be optimized with generator expressions or vectorized operations.
performance_issues.recommendation: Replace with generators or numpy/torch vectorized operations

performance_issues.name: Missing Memory Pooling
performance_issues.description: Frequent allocation/deallocation of objects without pooling. Especially problematic in tight training loops.
performance_issues.recommendation: Implement object pooling for frequently allocated objects

performance_issues.name: Inefficient String Operations
performance_issues.description: String concatenation in loops using + operator. Should use str.join() or StringIO for efficiency.
performance_issues.recommendation: Replace += string operations with join() or StringIO

performance_issues.name: Missing Caching Layers
performance_issues.description: Repeated computation of same values without memoization. Especially in preprocessing and data loading pipelines.
performance_issues.recommendation: Add LRU cache or memoization for expensive operations

performance_issues.name: Inefficient Model Initialization
performance_issues.description: Redundant weight initialization or unnecessary computations during model construction.

performance_issues.name: Suboptimal Tensor Operations
performance_issues.description: Using inefficient tensor operations (e.g., .cpu() when GPU preferred). Unnecessary data transfers between CPU/GPU.
performance_issues.recommendation: Minimize device transfers, use in-place operations

performance_issues.name: Missing Batch Size Optimization
performance_issues.description: Hardcoded batch sizes not optimized for hardware. Can lead to underutilization or OOM errors.
performance_issues.recommendation: Implement adaptive batch sizing based on available memory

performance_issues.name: Verbose Logging in Hot Paths
performance_issues.description: Debug or trace logging left enabled in production code. Logging overhead can be significant in tight loops.
performance_issues.recommendation: Use log levels appropriately, lazy string formatting

performance_issues.name: Inefficient Exception Handling
performance_issues.description: Catching exceptions in tight loops or using exceptions for control flow. Can significantly impact performance.
performance_issues.recommendation: Pre-validate conditions instead of exception-driven control

performance_issues.name: Missing Query Optimization
performance_issues.description: N+1 query problems, missing indexes, or inefficient SQL patterns. Database queries often dominate latency.
performance_issues.recommendation: Use query analysis, add indexes, implement query caching

performance_issues.name: Inefficient Network Serialization
performance_issues.description: Using inefficient serialization formats (e.g., JSON instead of binary). Affects API throughput and latency.
performance_issues.recommendation: Use protobuf, msgpack, or binary formats for hot paths
performance_issues.estimated_impact: 2-10x reduction in payload size and latency

performance_issues.name: Missing Connection Pooling
performance_issues.description: Creating new connections for each request instead of pooling. Connection establishment is expensive.
performance_issues.recommendation: Implement connection pooling with configurable pool size

recommendations.action: Address all CRITICAL severity performance issues
Implement batch database operations to eliminate N+1 patterns
Add internal buffering to monitoring and metrics collection
Optimize tensor operations and minimize device transfers
